meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 它可以搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先返回带 ID 的结果索引,再用时间线查看某条记录前后的上下文,最后只拉取你挑中的记录的完整内容。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话的事,比如「这个之前修过吗」「上次怎么解决的」等,就会触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决登录超时的?
say.note: 会先返回相关记录的索引表。

say.text: 搜一下 auth 相关的 bugfix 记录
say.note: 按类型和关键词过滤历史记录。

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整内容取出来
say.note: 一次请求批量取回完整记录。

howto.what_en: It searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: first returns an index of results with IDs, then shows timeline context around one, then fetches full details only for the records you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?"

say_en.text: How did we solve the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Returns a list of matching records first.
Filters past records by type and keyword.
Pulls complete records in one request.
